  "summary": "Backports seven merged master pull requests to the 32.x release branch (#36230, #36297, #36309, #36312, #36316, #36322, and #36324). Key updates optimize wallet descriptor comparisons, prevent address discouragement from affecting private broadcast peers, ensure fee estimates do not drop pending block updates during shutdown, correct OpenRPC metadata defaults, and resolve CI and test issues.",
  "problem": "The 32.x release branch lacks several fixes and cleanups present on master: shutdown unregisters fee estimation before draining queued validation callbacks (potentially dropping block updates and invalidating estimates across restarts), misbehaving private broadcast peers trigger standard IP discouragement, repeated canonical descriptor string generation slows down descriptor lookups, OpenRPC defaults contain non-literal hints, and Windows Nix cross-builds and HTTP throttling tests experience CI issues.",
  "evidence": [
    "Commit 8b93cadccc (#36322): 'Shutdown saves and unregisters the fee estimator before draining queued validation callbacks, so a pending block update can be missing from the saved estimates. The mempool estimator also ignores its saved file on restart when the saved tip no longer matches the active tip.'",
    "Commit 8ec0fd46f4 (#36312): 'Keep private broadcast connections outside normal discouragement handling. Misbehaving private broadcast peers are still disconnected.'",
    "Commit 7fdb8584da (#36230): 'The canonical string comparison was slow because it would compute the canonical string for each comparison. This can be sped up by holding the canonical string in memory... further hashed so that the comparison operates over the hash of the canonical string.'"

result.summary: Backports seven merged master pull requests to the 32.x release branch (#36230, #36297, #36309, #36312, #36316, #36322, and #36324). Key updates optimize wallet descriptor comparisons, prevent address discouragement from affecting private broadcast peers, ensure fee estimates do not drop pending block updates during shutdown, correct OpenRPC metadata defaults, and resolve CI and test issues.
result.problem: The 32.x release branch lacks several fixes and cleanups present on master: shutdown unregisters fee estimation before draining queued validation callbacks (potentially dropping block updates and invalidating estimates across restarts), misbehaving private broadcast peers trigger standard IP discouragement, repeated canonical descriptor string generation slows down descriptor lookups, OpenRPC defaults contain non-literal hints, and Windows Nix cross-builds and HTTP throttling tests experience CI issues.
evidence: Commit 8b93cadccc (#36322): 'Shutdown saves and unregisters the fee estimator before draining queued validation callbacks, so a pending block update can be missing from the saved estimates. The mempool estimator also ignores its saved file on restart when the saved tip no longer matches the active tip.'
Commit 8ec0fd46f4 (#36312): 'Keep private broadcast connections outside normal discouragement handling. Misbehaving private broadcast peers are still disconnected.'

Commit 7fdb8584da (#36230): 'The canonical string comparison was slow because it would compute the canonical string for each comparison. This can be sped up by holding the canonical string in memory... further hashed so that the comparison operates over the hash of the canonical string.'
result.scope_notes: This is a maintenance release backport bundle containing multiple distinct PRs already merged into master.
result.changed_since_previous: Added backports for #36312 (excluding private broadcast peers from standard network discouragement), #36322 (draining validation callbacks prior to saving fee estimates at shutdown), and #36324 (fixing a flaky HTTP throttling functional test).
result.card: Backports seven merged master PRs (#36230, #36297, #36309, #36312, #36316, #36322, #36324) to the 32.x release branch. Fixes include draining validation signals before shutdown to prevent lost fee estimation updates (#36322), preventing peer discouragement for private broadcast connections (#36312), speeding up wallet descriptor lookups via cached hashes (#36230), and correcting OpenRPC metadata defaults (#36297). All constituent patches have already been tested and merged into master.

risk.why: Modifications to shutdown callback sequencing, P2P peer disconnection logic, and wallet descriptor comparison could cause hangs during shutdown or improper peer disconnects if backported incorrectly.
